test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who is the author of the book titled 'The Midway Battle: Modi's Roller-Coaster Second Term', which was launched by Venkaiah Naidu in December 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gautam Chintamani**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vice President (VP) M. Venkaiah Naidu launched a book titled ‘The Midway Battle: Modi’s Roller-coaster Second Term’ authored by Gautam Chintamani in December 2021.
 
• The book was **published by Bloomsbury India** at **Upa-Rashtrapati Nivas, New Delhi.**
 
• The book mentioned the **political scenario of India after the second tenure of the current Prime Minister Narendra Modi.**
 
• **The book shed light on the various events in his tenure such as:**
 
 
• Jammu and Kashmir Reorganization Act.
 
• Triple talaq.
 
• The Citizenship (Amendment) Act.
 
• Farm laws.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Important Current Affairs are related to book releases in 2021-22.

 
 
• HarperCollins India has announced the acquisition of Vauhini Vara's debut novel - The Immortal King Rao.
 
• India's first-ever season style book 'The Class of 2006: Sneak Peek into the Misadventures of the Great Indian Engineering Life', has been released.
 
• It has been written by management professional Akash Kansal.
 
• It consists of 18 different episodes, each with a Learning Box.
 
• Shubira Prasad is the author of the book "The Angels of Kailash", a second book of the trilogy of the battle between humans and demons.
 
• Anukrti Upadhyay has won the Sushila Devi Award 2021 for the Best Book of Fiction for her critically acclaimed novel, Kintsugi in December 2021.
 
• The Vice President, M. Venkaiah Naidu released the book ‘Dr. V L Dutt: Glimpses of a Pioneer’s Life Journey written by V L Indira Dutt, Chairperson, and MD of KCP Group in Chennai.
 
• Vice President M. Venkaiah Naidu has released the memoir 'Raj Kapoor: The Master at Work' written by filmmaker Rahul Rawail on 14 December 2021.
 
• A new book that unearths true stories of the 1971 Indo-Pak war, ’1971: Charge of the Gorkhas and Other Stories, written by Rachna Bisht Rawat released in December 2021.
 
• A biography titled ‘Naoroji: Pioneer of Indian Nationalism’, authored by Dinyar Patel won the 4th Kamaladevi Chattopadhyay NIF (New India Foundation) Book Prize 2021.
 
• In December 2021, the Vice President of India, M. Venkaiah Naidu launched a book titled ‘Public Service Ethics- A Quest for Naitik Bharat’, authored by Prabhat Kumar.
 
• In December 2021, the Vice President of India, M. Venkaiah Naidu on the 72nd anniversary of the adoption of the ‘Constitution of India’ released a book titled “Democracy, Politics, and Governance”, authored by Dr. A. Surya Prakash.
